items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: We once played for a prize fight in Chicago and Al Capone held my trombone case.

ctx.x: Because I get them mixed up to see.
Those two. And as mentioned in the article in the record changer, Al Capone is holding Tom's trombone case right there. You can see him in the car.
